title: Report Analysis and Copy
description: The written half of the State of AI in Design Systems study (July 2026): the findings, the essay, the methodology, the caveats, and the per-page ledes. One object, not a collection. Everything here is prose written about the records rather than quoted from a source, which is why nothing in this file carries a source URL.

lede.description: One paragraph under a page's title. Rendered on both the HTML route and its markdown twin, so it has to read on its own.

paragraphs.description: One string per paragraph. The build joins them; do not embed blank lines.

reading_lede.description: The bar the further-reading list is held to. It is the page lede and the standard a suggestion is judged against, which is why it is one sentence a contributor can read before they send a link.

findings.description: The numbered findings. Order is meaningful: the site numbers them by position, so reordering renumbers them.

methodology.description: How the data was gathered, including who gathered it and when.

caveats.description: What the study does not support. The staleness caveat belongs here.
